content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold leaf and cedar, with a painting of the last supper that swaps the lamb for a local treat."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From bean to bar, with a chance to taste cacao the old way."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Under a dome of stars, the southern sky tells its own sweet history."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the whole city, and Inti (the sun) warming the old walls."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A riot of colours, fruit juices and woven things, with the hum of the market all around."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Cobbled lanes full of little workshops and balconies, perfect for a slow wander."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold, textiles and stories of the Inca world tucked into a fine old colonial house."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with stories and golden light off the stone arcades."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Inca stonework so precise even Inti (the sun) seems to pause and admire it."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A white statue on the hill, watching the city blush as the light fades."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Plant-based plates with a Peruvian wink, and the pisco sours are not shy."}]}
Golden light, Inca stones, stars, the valley, and a soft goodbye — all here, amigo.
